summary: Beaverhead County, MT live-in tower dated 1955 by firelookout.com, now abandoned and gone; a 1956 survey description suggests it stood then. Nothing on the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains on the summit

events.note: firelookout.com gives 1955 for a live-in tower that it calls abandoned and gone; the entry does not say whether 1955 is the build year or the abandonment year
Survey station description written 1956 gives directions past a sign reading TOWER MTN LOOKOUT TOWER

evidence.supports: survey description written by Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1956
evidence.quote: DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1956 (WFD)

evidence.supports: summit about 13 miles northwest of Dillon per survey description
road sign reading TOWER MTN LOOKOUT TOWER
FFLA lists Tower Mountain in Beaverhead as a tower that is gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Distance from Dillon differs: firelookout.com says 18 miles NNW, the survey description says about 13 miles NW. Unresolved; both are cited.

notes_for_editor: Only the firelookout.com entry, a 1956 NGS station description reproduced on Forest Lookouts, and the FFLA list say anything about this site. The 1955 date may be the build year or the abandonment year, and the source does not say which. The NGS text describes a survey station, not the lookout itself. Two web searches found no other history for a Montana Tower Mountain lookout; results were for Oregon and Washington sites. No staffing or fire information found.
